supported_fields.mechanics_notes: 400-Stamina Ki Blast Evasive used by Broly (DB Super). The user creates a large green pillar that acts as a temporary barrier and permits immediate Awoken Skill activation. Current dedicated evidence identifies 12–23 hits and an extended runtime for Broly (DBS); the unique Awoken interaction is part of the move's documented design.
supported_fields.source_quest_or_shop: Conton City Patrol 10 — Teach Me, Broly! (Part 2)
